name: E-books (EPUB)
install_note: Check needs epubcheck and Java: fetch the official epubcheck-X.zip (github.com/w3c/epubcheck, about 33 MB) into ~/.local/share/cockpit/tools/epubcheck/ with a wrapper "epubcheck" in ~/.local/bin that runs java -jar .../epubcheck.jar "$@"; Java: sudo apt install default-jre-headless. Build needs pandoc.
description: Write, build and validate an EPUB book. The markdown source stays the master: Build makes an EPUB 3 from a folder of chapters (every .md in number order, a metadata.yaml, a style.css, an optional cover) with pandoc; Check runs epubcheck, the official validator that stores and libraries use, and reports each problem as file(line,col) with its code (RSC-012, OPF-003 ...); Inspect shows what is inside an EPUB (version, title, author, language, chapters, images, fonts, scripts, remote resources, cover, accessibility metadata); New book starts a skeleton. Markdown that refers to files outside the book folder or to the network is refused at build time, so a build cannot pull a file from elsewhere into the book.

presets.label: Validate the EPUB (epubcheck)
presets.description: The official validator: every error and warning as file(line,col) with the epubcheck code. A book that fails here is refused by most stores.

presets.label: Inspect: what is inside the EPUB
presets.description: EPUB version, title, author, language, identifier, date, rights, reading order, navigation document, cover, chapters, images, fonts, CSS, scripts, size, and what is worth a look (no cover, scripts, remote resources, images over 1 MB, no accessibility metadata).

presets.label: Build an EPUB from markdown
presets.description: The input is the book folder (every .md in number order, metadata.yaml, style.css) or one .md file. Type options in the extra arguments: title="My Book" author="A. Name" lang=en cover=cover.png. A table of contents is made from the headings; each # heading starts a new chapter file.

presets.label: New book (skeleton)
presets.description: Creates NAME/ in the folder you give: metadata.yaml (title, author, language, date, rights, an identifier), two chapters and a style.css. Type the name in the extra arguments. Never overwrites.
